**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Distinguish failed first payments before activating**

An `incomplete` subscription with a bank default is not necessarily awaiting settlement: the provider documents that a subscription becomes `incomplete` when its first payment attempt fails ([Subscription status](https://docs.example.com/api/subscriptions/object)). Because this branch treats every such subscription as `ACTIVE`, a failed payment can still grant the purchased tier.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Fixed in 6b13e62. `isPendingFirstPayment` no longer keys off the default payment method; it activates only when the latest invoice is `processing`. Regression tests cover processing, failed and microdeposit cases.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recreate the session when the flag flips**

When the flag is off, an open checkout session created with the bank rail is reused as-is, so the customer still sees the old payment options.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
Fixed in 91ac0de. Sessions record the offered rails in metadata and are expired and recreated when they differ.

### Failed bank debits stay active **High Severity** `isPendingFirstPayment` treats every `incomplete` subscription whose `default_payment_method` is a bank account as `ACTIVE`. A failed first debit stays `incomplete` with that method still attached, so reconciliation keeps granting entitlements until expiry.
Additional Locations (1) - [`src/providers/payments/client.ts#L500-L507`](https://github.com/acme/widgets/blob/0e03162/src/providers/payments/client.ts#L500-L507)

 

Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 0e03162. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard?tab=bugbot).
Fixed in 6b13e62. The provider now expands `latest_invoice.payment_intent`; a first debit in `requires_payment_method` stays SETUP_PENDING.

### Flag-off checkout reuses bank session **Medium Severity** With the flag off, `findOpenSession` returns a session created while it was on, so the bank rail is still offered.
Additional Locations (1) - [`src/onboarding/session-metadata.ts#L12-L20`](https://github.com/acme/widgets/blob/0e03162/src/onboarding/session-metadata.ts#L12-L20)
